title: GitHub Release cut: refuse an existing vX whose notes differ, or that is a draft or prerelease (pair with lore-cli LCLI-622)
description: Raised by lore-cli on 2026-09-28 while pairing LCLI-622 with QCLI-398 (their note "DESIGN PAIRING (QCLI-398 @0f671906)" on opum-ai/lore-cli branch feat/LCLI-622-executed-github-release, head bf1ef960). Verified here against origin/dev 0f67190, scripts/github-release.mjs blob 89c24028: ensureGitHubRelease runs `gh release view vX --json tagName`, and on success treats the release as done and marks it latest. It never reads the body, isDraft or isPrerelease. So a stale or hand-edited release passes as done, and a draft or prerelease vX would be marked latest without anyone looking. lore-cli is implementing the stricter rule. To keep the paired accept/refuse verdicts identical, quest adopts both. (a) An existing vX whose body, after trimming and CRLF normalisation, differs from the CHANGELOG section is a failure. At the pre-move check it refuses before anything moves. The release is never edited. (b) An existing vX that is a draft or prerelease is refused pre-move and never edited. lore-only differences that were agreed, and are NOT in scope here: heading regex, exit code 3 for a post-latest failure, the npmrc cleanup mechanism, JSDoc typing vs .d.mts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ensureGitHubRelease reads body, isDraft and isPrerelease in the same gh release view call it already makes, not in a second call

An existing vX whose trimmed, CRLF-normalised body differs from the CHANGELOG notes returns ok:false, and promote-release refuses at the pre-move check (dry run and --promote) before any dist-tag moves
An existing vX that is a draft or a prerelease returns ok:false and is refused at the pre-move check before any dist-tag moves
No path edits an existing release body, draft or prerelease state; the only permitted edit remains --latest on a matching, published release

Each refusal is covered by a stubbed-gh test that fails against the pre-change module, and an existing release with identical notes (including a CRLF-only difference) still passes and is marked latest
lore-cli confirms the refuse/accept verdicts match LCLI-622 for all three existing-release states

plan: 1. Widen the existing view call to --json tagName,body,isDraft,isPrerelease and parse it; unparseable output is an unreadable state (ok:false).

2. On an existing release, refuse a draft or prerelease, then refuse a body that differs from the notes after CRLF normalisation and trimming, before the not-latest, dry-run and mark-latest branches. Never edit.

3. promote-release needs no change: its pre-move check already calls ensureGitHubRelease with dryRun:true on both dry run and --promote and refuses on ok:false; pin that with a test reusing the existing order test.
4. Stubbed-gh tests that fail on the pre-change module; update the existing exists-path stubs to return matching JSON. CHANGELOG entry. PR, then send lore-cli the head SHA.
implementationNotes: Evidence. test/qcli401-existing-release-state.test.ts was run against the unchanged module on the 5548ac4 tree. 5 failed: differing notes, draft, prerelease, the view reading only tagName, and unparseable view output treated as a pass. The matching-notes test and the promote-order test passed before the change, by design. They pin behaviour that must hold, not the defect. After the change all 25 tests in the 398 and 401 files pass. The existing QCLI-398 exists-path stubs now return a published release with notes "N". Before, their stdout was empty, which the new parser correctly treats as unreadable. The three refusals are asserted in all of dry run, --promote with latest, and not-latest. In each one the view is the ONLY gh call, so nothing is edited. A missing isDraft or isPrerelease key is treated as not-false and refused, so it fails closed. bun run check: 864 pass, 0 fail. AC6 (lore-cli confirms the verdicts match LCLI-622) stays open until they reply against this PR head.
